name: Clickable Field Label (link-styled button as label)
description: A field whose LABEL half is a link-styled btn that opens a popup, instead of a plain lbl. Used where the caption names a setting the user may want to change — the caption itself becomes the affordance. atoms/text-button.json documented buttons on the value side of a field; this is the label side.
sourceRefs: examples/fapo-fapi-full-breakdown.md 6.2 (Summary → 'VAT Amount' caption opens the VAT-treatment popup)

tooltip.description: Native browser tooltip via props.title, e.g. "Click to update VAT Treatment of Party".

sourceQuirks: In the real source `resolveprops:true` sits at NODE level (outside props) on this button, while every other control on the page puts it inside props. Both forms are accepted by the engine; this template uses the inside-props form.

The real source also carries appendprops:{"disabled":""} — an empty string where a page-mode expression was presumably intended. It is falsy and harmless, but it is dead weight; omitted from this template. Add a real expression if you need conditional disabling.
props.title is the only native tooltip anywhere in the captured page.
